units.source_text: 唐人刘禹锡《有所嗟》诗云：

en.t: The Tang poet Liu Yuxi wrote in his poem "A Sigh":

units.source_text: “庾令楼中初见时，武昌春柳似腰支。

en.t: "When I first saw her in Lord Yu's tower, the spring willows of Wuchang seemed as slender as her waist.

units.source_text: 相逢相失两如梦，为雨为云今不知。”

en.t: Meeting and parting were both like dreams; whether she has become rain or cloud, I do not know now."
